text: First real run of the endless loop on Aimparency's own graph (aim B), with a cross-family verifier and human-gated decompositions
description:
Aim B (Felix 2026-11-09): let AI venture into the future in an endless loop with self-made hypotheses and ideas. The harness (5949b781) has run only on a throwaway project and an offline eval. This is the first run on v7 itself.

READINESS CHECK (2026-11-09, OBSERVED): .bowman/runtime/loops.json 'Default loop' = nvidia / z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, intervalSeconds 5, roles {} (so planner, executor, verifier and reflector are all glm: no cross-family verification), worktreePath null (it would edit the shared working tree where Felix and other agents commit), no .bowman/harness.json (defaults: executor builtin, decomposition.landingState open). secrets.json has NVIDIA_API_KEY only. The NVIDIA endpoint lists 84 models, including other families: deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash, moonshotai/kimi-k2.6, mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, openai/gpt-oss-20b.

PROPOSED CONFIG (not written):
1. loops.json Default loop: roles.verifier = { provider: nvidia, model: deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash }, roles.reflector the same; intervalSeconds 60; worktreePath = a separate git worktree of v7 (e.g. ../v7-loop on branch loop/main), merged by Felix or after verification.
2. .bowman/harness.json: { decomposition: { landingState: 'ai-proposition', maxChildren: 5 }, budgets: { maxTokensPerCycle: 400000 } } so strategy-level children wait for Felix (5e431a84) while leaves under accepted ideas run.
3. Stop rule for the first run: 10 cycles or 24 h, whichever first; then read traces (.bowman/runtime/loop-instances/<id>/), count verified/failed/unverifiable verdicts and ai-propositions created, and record them here.

Success: at least one leaf verified by the cross-family verifier and committed with evidence; no edits outside the worktree; every created child carries a hypothesis. Refuted (for now) if most verdicts are unverifiable or the verifier rubber-stamps (accepts a deliberately broken claim in a spot check).

REPETITION (RESEARCHED: Nachkov, Wang, Van Gool, 'LLM Agents Beyond Utility: An Open-Ended Perspective', arXiv 2510.14548 — a goal-generating agent with memory proposed and solved its own tasks but was 'prone to repetitive task generation'; evaluating self-tasking agents is an open problem): also measure, per run, the share of harness-created ideas within cosine >= 0.92 of an existing or cancelled idea (find_duplicate_ideas over the run's new ids) and how many of its proposals repeat a proposal from an earlier cycle. A rising rate across runs is the signal that the loop circles instead of venturing forward.

status.comment: Prepared (config, checklist, stop rule in the description). Felix: say 'go' (I write the config, create the worktree and you press Start in the Loop panel), or change any of: verifier model, worktree vs shared tree, landingState.
